text:
Maya Lin: quick async pulse — finalizing the quarterly OKR milestone tally for infra+product shared work. Can people post what actually shipped vs slipped, plus 1 next step/owner? cc @Aj @Leo
Aj Patel: shipped — routing policy canary (10% traffic). slipped — autoscale smoothing (integration tests failing). next: Dmitri to triage infra test failures by EOD.
Leo Zhang: shipped — embed caching prototype landed (PR merged to staging). slipped — dedupe job (blocked on config schema). next: I can pick up schema change, need a +1 on the config shape from product.
Sarah O'Connor: pulled CRs for dedupe job, left a few comments. will re-review after Leo updates.
Dmitri Ivanov: seeing CI flake on the autoscale e2e — reproducer locally: 
```
ERROR: oom when allocating kv_cache_alloc
node-gpu-2:230: RuntimeError
```
Working on a smaller repro and reaching out to infra to bump GPU quotas. ETA 6 hrs.
Aj Patel: thanks — that matches the failure in canary logs. DeployBot: Canary ramp to 10% :white_check_mark: (routing-policy-v2)
Maya Lin: good. for OKR sheet I'll mark routing policy as shipped and autoscale as partial/slipped. Need a short note for product: impact and mitigation. Aj can you paste a 1-2 line blurb?
Aj Patel: blurb for sheet: "Routing policy v2 deployed canary; provides cost-aware routing. Autoscale smoothing delayed due to e2e flake; mitigation: revert to conservative scaling window and patch tests; target finish within this sprint."
Leo Zhang: for dedupe job, owner = Leo, blocker = config schema review. next step: @Sarah to thumb the schema by EOD tomorrow.
Sarah O'Connor: can do EOD tomorrow. also tagging product for priority: @Maya please confirm if dedupe must ship this quarter or can move to next.
Maya Lin: product input: dedupe is nice-to-have for this quarter, not mandatory. priority is routing policy + autoscale.
Dmitri Ivanov: updating issue with repro + temporary test skip. assigning to infra and Aj for follow-up.
Aj Patel: I'll follow up with infra and post status here when CI green.
Maya Lin: next steps summary: 1) Aj — infra CI follow-up + autoscale mitigation (owner) 2) Dmitri — repro & temp test skip (owner) 3) Leo — schema tweak + merge dedupe PR (owner) 4) Sarah — review + signoff (owner) I'll update the OKR doc after Aj posts CI status. Thanks all :thumbsup:
